body.message:
Thank you. Yes, I’d like to arrange a viewing for this weekend as I’m very interested in the apartment and, if everything is as expected during the viewing, I’d be looking to move forward quite quickly.

Before I proceed, could you please confirm a few details for me:

• The rent is AED 8,500 per month and I can pay monthly rather than paying several months in advance.

• AED 8,500 is the total monthly rental amount, with water and electricity included and no additional monthly service, management or utility charges.

• Please confirm how long the AED 8,500 monthly rate is fixed for and whether there is a minimum rental period.

• The refundable security deposit is AED 1,500, and please confirm whether there are any other one-off fees payable at check-in or during the tenancy.

• I would prefer to arrange my own high-speed internet connection, as I require a very fast and reliable connection for work. Please confirm whether I am able to have my own internet service installed in the apartment.

• Please confirm whether the parking space is included.

• Could you also send me the registration card/agreement and full terms and conditions in advance so I can review everything before making payment?

If all of the above is confirmed and I’m happy with the apartment after the viewing, I’d be happy to proceed promptly.

Please let me know what viewing times you have available this weekend. Thank you.
